hermes-agent — Nous Research
Source: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent (commit 868b9f244f5aa3ad238e494048046fe4f29c28ba)
License: MIT

Used in Damn-Bot (benchmark/test data only, not shipped in the damnbot binary):
- bench/budget/testdata/hermes-868b9f244f/** — snapshots of the hermes system prompt, context and tool schemas
- bench/h2h/results/**/*.hermes.proxy.jsonl.gz, bench/h2h/results/**/ts11.proxy.jsonl.gz,
  bench/h2h/results/**/background.proxy.jsonl.gz — recorded LLM traffic containing hermes prompts and tool schemas
- bench/evals/sources/hermes-skills.tsv — name/description from hermes SKILL.md frontmatter
See docs/ATTRIBUTION.md for the full list (ADR-018).
